title: Jockey Assignment Matching Residual
hypothesis: Within the observed same-race jockey roster, the realized horse-jockey matching contains residual information beyond known horse/jockey ability, jockey continuity, trainer-jockey history, weight feasibility and EXP01 raw-choice controls, and that residual remains against terminal_close_market.
conclusion_scope: conditional assignment within the observed same-race roster; no claim about unobserved offers, refusals, contracts, agents or intent
hard_prohibitions: no implementation or training before Fable review and freeze
no ROI, ticket generation or stake allocation
no pair-ID embedding or raw identity memorization
no rescue by changing candidate-set definitions after outcomes

prior_art_boundary.EXP01: horse-row raw choice and team-deviation model; residual deviation had no unique value
prior_art_boundary.EXP11: sparse jockey-trainer pair selection; do not repeat pair-ID mining
prior_art_boundary.EXP15: race-as-set prediction; not an assignment model
prior_art_boundary.EXP16A_EXP18: terminal-close residual must be the first performance gate
prior_art_boundary.novelty: one-to-one horse-jockey assignment over the observed race roster with an explicit constrained-matching null

rules: exclude maiden races from the primary analysis
valid horse, jockey and trainer IDs
one observed jockey per starter and no within-race jockey duplication
exclude DNF-containing races from Stage 1 primary set for existing OOF compatibility; report as outcome-conditioned exclusion
all arms use identical race and starter sets
population.crosscheck: report race-id differences against the EXP16A/EXP17 official flat DNF-excluded set

candidate_sets.interpretation: swap-feasible set conditional on the observed same-race jockey roster; not the true offer set
candidate_sets.C0_primary: horse x observed-race-jockey roster, constrained by jockey minimum carried weight over the prior 365 days
candidate_sets.C2_sensitivity: complete observed-roster bipartite graph without weight constraint

assignment_models.A0_B1: independent-edge conditional-logit null using raw and marginal controls
assignment_models.fit_rule: year Y uses Y-1 and earlier only; regularization fixed with <=2018 assignment labels

stage0.time_safety: future deletion, target/same-day outcome mutation, day-start snapshot, order permutation, doubly-stochastic, infeasible-edge, ID-relabel, reproducibility and loader-separation tests must all pass

power.metric: race winner categorical logloss against terminal-close offset null
power.economic_floor: EXP18 v0.5 finite-sample estimator with terminal odds, cash-inclusive Kelly, 20% takeout and 1e-4 expected log growth per race

stage1_arms.M0_CLOSE: rolling temperature-calibrated terminal close win market
stage1_arms.M1_CLEAN: M0_CLOSE + EXP16A R0-clean rolling OOF score
stage1_arms.M2_RAW_ASSIGN: M1_CLEAN + EXP01 raw jockey/choice controls + A0 edge controls

all_required: improvement direction in at least 4 of 5 years
real delta below the 2.5th percentile of P1, P2 and P3
deterministic bit reproducibility or improvement in at least 4 of 5 non-identical predeclared refits
gate_M.PASS_SIGNAL: all requirements but practical floor not reached; record and stop
gate_M.pre_market: diagnostic only; cannot rescue a terminal-close failure

placebos.P1_JOCKEY_ID_REWIRE: degree-preserving rewire within venue-day and race-size band, preserving jockey card load
placebos.P2_EDGE_DIRECTION_NULL: within-race sign reversal or horse permutation preserving the residual multiset
placebos.P3_ROSTER_SWAP: borrow a jockey roster from another race in the same venue, month and field-size band, then rebuild candidates and matching
placebos.P4_IDENTITY_FREE: remove jockey/trainer identity history and retain only weight, card-load and marginal-quality controls
placebos.fit_rule: rerun rolling fitting for each evidential placebo

stop_rules: candidate-set coverage or observed-edge feasibility floor fails
assignment model B2 does not improve B1
residual can be reconstructed from EXP01/raw controls with cross-fit R2 >= 0.80
any time-safety or matching invariant fails
